model: ID281 / ID281 Pro superconducting nanowire single-photon detector systems
description: Fibre-coupled SNSPD systems (1-16 channels, SDE 80-95%, <500 nm to >2000 nm) in automated closed-cycle cryostats: ID281 Pro rack-mounted continuous operation (<3 K) and ID281 SO sorption cryostat (<1 K) for QKD, quantum optics and single-photon source characterisation.

configurations.name: ID281 Pro rack-mounted continuous-operation SNSPD system (up to 16 channels) with rack vacuum pump and air-cooled compressor options
configurations.configuration_basis: ID Quantique ID281 Pro as specified in the brochure specification table: closed-cycle cryostat (cryo unit 8U), detector base temperature <3 K, up to 16 single-mode-fibre-coupled SNSPD channels (FC/PC inputs, SMA RF outputs), 24/7 continuous operation, with the rack-mounted vacuum pump (4U) and air-cooled rack-mounted compressor (6U) options on which the printed specs are based. ID1000 time controller not included. Detectors are factory-installed; there is no user sample space.

configurations.name: ID281 SO (SOrption) sub-kelvin SNSPD system, 1 to 16 channels
configurations.configuration_basis: ID Quantique ID281 SO cryostat as specified in the ID281 brochure: closed-cycle cryostat with sorption stage, detector base temperature <1 K, runtime at base >=24 h with an automated daily helium condensation cycle, 1-16 single-mode-fibre-coupled SNSPD channels, cryostat 63 x 45 x 30 cm. ID1000 time controller not included. Detectors are factory-installed; there is no user sample space.

unknowns.why: The brochure gives only 'Detector base temperature <3K', an upper bound. No operating point at 3 K is documented, so storing lo = hi = 3 K asserts something the source does not say. temperature.base (min 3 K) already captures the fact conservatively.

Light reaches the detectors only by single-mode fibre (FC/PC), and the claim itself says no free-space window is specified. The project convention (photonics experiments notes) defines optical_access as a window onto the sample, with fibre-coupled systems deliberately excluded. Setting it true would falsely satisfy free-space optical-access requirements.
Only 'Detector base temperature <1K' (ID281 SO column) is given, an upper bound with no documented operating point at 1 K. lo = hi = 1 K is not supported. temperature.base covers it.
Fibre-coupled only ('Single mode fibre'; multimode on request), with no free-space window. The project convention excludes fibre-coupled systems from optical_access (a window onto the sample).
